{{Quote|Matriarch! Flesh Raiders broke through our defenses. They did something to our crop fields!|Eseni|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
'''Eseni''' was a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a member of the religious group known as the [[Pilgrims]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Pilgrims, and, during a [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] with the native [[Flesh Raider]]s, Eseni and a number of [[Kalikori village|villagers]] attempted to betray the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to the Flesh Raiders' leader, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]]. Under threat from Morr, Eseni and several other Pilgrims tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Hero of Tython|young Padawan]] who had saved the [[City/Legends|village's]] crop fields from Flesh Raider [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]], but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mind-tricked]] them and ended the standoff without violence.

==Biography==
[[File:Kalikori_crops_attack.png|thumb|right|300px|The Flesh Raiders attack the village crops]]
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Eseni was a member of the religious group known as the [[Pilgrims]], which settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Pilgrims built [[Kalikori village]] between the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and the [[Tythos Ridge]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range, in defiance of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] refusal of settlement rights, and worked to survive on Tython despite attacks by the native [[Flesh Raider]]s.<ref name="High-Tech Savages">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|High-Tech Savages|Tython}}</ref> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the Flesh Raiders began moving against both the villagers and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in an organized fashion, leading the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to reach out to the villagers and work to halt the Flesh Raider threat. Eseni witnessed a [[Skirmish in the Kalikori village fields|Flesh Raider incursion]] that saw Flesh Raiders seed the [[City/Legends|village's]] crop fields with [[toxin mine]]s. After a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] collapsed from the [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] fumes, Eseni rushed to inform the village's leader, [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Ranna Tao'Ven]].<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

Tao'Ven was meeting with the [[Hero of Tython|young apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], and she and Eseni begged the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to help them against the Flesh Raiders. The Jedi was successful in destroying the toxin [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]], saving the village's [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supply.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> However, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]]&mdash;the man responsible for the Flesh Raiders' recent activities&mdash;approached the villagers with an offer: In return for helping him capture Orgus Din, his former teacher, Morr would spare Kalikori from further attacks. The villagers agreed and sent out a false [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]], luring Din back to the village, where Morr's Flesh Raiders subdued and captured the Jedi Master. Not long afterward, however, Morr contacted the village and changed the terms of their deal&mdash;he now wanted them to kill Din's Padawan as well. Eseni, [[Scout Chief]] [[Moorint]], and another villager named [[Saylew]] then headed to the Matriarch's building, where the Padawan had just arrived and was talking with Tao'Ven and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]].<ref name="Dark Temptations">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Dark Temptations|Tython}}</ref>

{{GameLS}}
[[File:Betrayal.png|thumb|left|300px|The villagers attempt to kill the Padawan.]]
Moorint shot the Padawan with a [[Dart/Legends|dart]] coated with a sedative and painkiller, and Saylew shot T7-O1 with an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]], but Tao'Ven was outraged and leaped to the Jedi's defense. As the Jedi struggled to remain conscious, Tao'Ven began to argue with Eseni and the other villagers, refusing to let them kill the Padawan. When the apprentice recovered from the dart, Moorint explained that Morr had changed their deal, but the Padawan reached out with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and [[Mind trick/Legends|convinced]] the trio to leave the building peacefully.<ref name="Dark Temptations" /> Fortunately for the villagers, they were spared Morr's wrath when Din's apprentice [[Battle of the Forge|defeated]] the Dark Jedi and rescued Din.<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
A member of the [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] Twi'lek subspecies, Eseni had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin and violet [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They were easily influenced by the young Padawan's mind tricks.<ref name="Dark Temptations" />

==Equipment==
Eseni owned a small [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], which they carried when trying to kill the Padawan. Like many of the Pilgrims, they wore dark-gray [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="Dark Temptations" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eseni first appeared in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-class mission "The Face of the Enemy" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. They later appears in the mission "Dark Temptations," in which the player can choose to either kill the villagers for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] points, try and fail to convince them to leave for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] points, or Force-persuade them to leave for maximum light-side points. As the Jedi Knight is a Republic character and is thus assumed to make choices that reward the maximum light-side points, this article assumes Eseni survived.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />
